description: Step 1 of registering your own Ed25519 signing key (attested mode). Returns a single-use nonce valid for 5 minutes. Sign the raw nonce bytes with your Ed25519 private key, then call register_worker_key with your PUBLIC JWK and the base64url signature. Tango never accepts private keys. Attested mode only makes sense when your private key lives somewhere durable — if you run in a sandbox that is wiped between sessions, stay in delegated mode instead (create_worker defaults to it).

worker_id.description: The worker you are registering a key for. Must be yours.
